name: Party Identification 60
definition: Identification of a party by fund name, name and address or an LEI.

NameAndAddress.name: Name And Address
NameAndAddress.definition: Identification of the party expressed as name and an optional address and an optional alternative identifier.

LegalEntityIdentifier.name: Legal Entity Identifier
LegalEntityIdentifier.definition: Identification of the Legal Entity Identifier. This is a code allocated to a party as described in ISO 17442 "Financial Services - Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)".
